verdict.rationale: doola documents its own annual-report filing capability: it reads state requirements and fees, puts a company's annual report on file, confirms it and tracks it to completion, and it keeps a compliance calendar of recurring obligations. That filing is exposed through the Partner API, not explicitly as a founder-purchasable managed service or add-on, and the founder-facing Registered Agent plan only promises 'notifications' for annual reports. missing for 10: explicit founder-facing managed annual-report filing service or add-on, pricing for the filing service, evidence that doola prepares the report contents, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a founder, I can have the provider prepare and file my annual reports as a managed service or add-on

citations.quote: Read what a state asks and charges, put a company's annual report on file, confirm it, and follow it to completion.
A company's compliance calendar lists the recurring obligations doola tracks to keep it in good standing.
